class.name: CullDistanceProfile3D
class.brief_description: Bounded, deterministic size-to-cull-distance profiles for 3D scenery.
class.description: Resolves the visibility end distance from an object's axis-aligned bounding box and size/range pairs, inspired by Cull Distance Volumes in Unreal Engine. The object's size is the longest dimension of [param bounds], not its area or diagonal. Pairs are matched by nearest size with no interpolation. Pair order does not matter, and equally near pairs use the smallest positive cull range (0 means no extra culling). A positive [param authored_distance] is always an upper limit, so the result never increases it. Zero means unlimited. The method is pure and never changes visibility, render state or game objects; callers choose whether to apply it. Inputs must be finite and non-negative, with 1–128 pairs, size and distance up to 1,000,000, and bounds positions within +/-10,000,000. Invalid inputs return -1, distinguishable from the valid unlimited distance 0.

method.name: configure
method.description: Atomically stores 1–128 validated size/range pairs for repeated cull-distance queries. Rejects invalid, mismatched, negative, nonfinite or out-of-bounds input without changing an existing configured profile. Repeated identical configuration is harmless. Pairs are read-only snapshots; caller edits do not modify the configured values.

method.name: get_pair_count
method.description: Returns the number of configured pairs, or zero when no profile has been configured or after [method clear_profile].

method.name: clear_profile
method.description: Clears previously configured size/range pairs. Subsequent cached queries return -1 until configuration succeeds.

method.name: get_cached_cull_distance
method.description: Uses stored pairs to resolve each object's longest AABB dimension, without passing or revalidating the same profile arrays for each instance. Bounds and author cap are validated on every call. Returns -1 for invalid bounds, cap or unconfigured profile. Selection and no-interpolation semantics are identical to [method get_cull_distance]. Pure data API: callers set visibility themselves.

method.name: get_cached_cull_distances
method.description: Bulk version of [method get_cached_cull_distance] for up to 4096 objects. Pass index-aligned local AABB positions, AABB sizes and authored caps. Returns the same number of size-based cull distances in the same order, after validating all rows. Unconfigured profiles, mismatched lengths, more than 4096 entries, invalid boxes, or nonfinite/negative/out-of-range caps reject the entire batch with an empty array. Does not modify the scene or automatically cull anything. The caller remains responsible for rendering changes and batching smaller requests.

method.name: get_cull_distance
method.description: Returns a draw distance for the object's longest bounds dimension. A zero range pair does not override an authored positive cap; positive ranges are clamped by that cap. Returns -1 when any input is invalid, and 0 only for valid unlimited visibility.
